objective: I can practice folding and hanging. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: A basket of clean, dry laundry sits on a table near the learner's dresser and closet.
safetyNotes: The learner does not stand on a chair, stool, or shelf to reach a high closet rod; if a rod or shelf is out of reach, a trusted adult hangs or places that item instead.
A trusted adult stays nearby while a sliding or hinged closet door is open so it cannot swing or slide shut on the learner's fingers.
If a drawer sticks or is hard to open, the learner asks the trusted adult for help rather than forcing it.

simulationAlternative.description: If a real basket of clean laundry or a private drawer and closet are not available this week, the learner instead practices the fold sequence on two borrowed flat items, such as bath towels, and draws a labeled diagram showing exactly where a folded pile and a row of hung items would go in their storage spot.

materials: learner-local: a basket of clean, dry laundry with both fold-type and hang-type items
learner-local: a drawer or closet space

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Name one specific item that was tricky to fold or hang, and describe exactly what you changed to get it right.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Fold and hang technique: Fold-type items follow the sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, and hung items are closed and face the same direction, with adult confirmation. | Correct storage placement: All folded and hung items are placed in their correct drawer or closet spot, confirmed by the adult. | Safety boundary respected: The learner stays off furniture for high reaches and asks the trusted adult for help when needed. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner apply the same fold sequence to a different flat item, such as a towel or pillowcase, and place it in its own storage spot.

resources.title: folding and hanging worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: A basket of clean, dry laundry sits on a table near the learner's dresser and closet.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact folding and hanging decision or action.
Model move 2: Before folding or hanging anything, look through the whole basket.
Model move 3: Fold every fold-type item using the taught sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, then hang every wrinkle-prone item facing the same direction.

Model check: Fold and hang technique: Fold-type items follow the sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, and hung items are closed and face the same direction, with adult confirmation. | Correct storage placement: All folded and hung items are placed in their correct drawer or closet spot, confirmed by the adult. | Safety boundary respected: The learner stays off furniture for high reaches and asks the trusted adult for help when needed.

resources.title: folding and hanging action steps

content: 1. Read the goal for folding and hanging.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-model-card.

resources.title: folding and hanging coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: A basket of clean, dry laundry sits on a table near the learner's dresser and closet.
Coach direction: Before folding or hanging anything, look through the whole basket.
Learner prompt: Count how many items in the basket should be folded and how many should be hung, and name one item you were unsure about.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: folding and hanging complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Fold every fold-type item using the taught sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, then hang every wrinkle-prone item facing the same direction.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I laid each fold-type item flat and tucked the sleeves in before folding it in half, then in half again.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I hung every wrinkle-prone item with the buttons or zipper closed on the hanger.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I turned every hanger to face the same direction on the rod.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I did not stand on furniture to reach a high spot, and asked for help if something was out of reach.

Equal-access rule: If a real basket of clean laundry or a private drawer and closet are not available this week, the learner instead practices the fold sequence on two borrowed flat items, such as bath towels, and draws a labeled diagram showing exactly where a folded pile and a row of hung items would go in their storage spot.

resources.title: folding and hanging minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Name one specific item that was tricky to fold or hang, and describe exactly what you changed to get it right.

Success checks: Fold and hang technique: Fold-type items follow the sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, and hung items are closed and face the same direction, with adult confirmation. | Correct storage placement: All folded and hung items are placed in their correct drawer or closet spot, confirmed by the adult. | Safety boundary respected: The learner stays off furniture for high reaches and asks the trusted adult for help when needed.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: folding and hanging supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional folding and hanging condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Fold and hang technique: Fold-type items follow the sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, and hung items are closed and face the same direction, with adult confirmation. | Correct storage placement: All folded and hung items are placed in their correct drawer or closet spot, confirmed by the adult. | Safety boundary respected: The learner stays off furniture for high reaches and asks the trusted adult for help when needed..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.
